data.gender_notes: Aatikah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aatikah is a Quranic name that refers to a person who is deeply grateful to Allah for his blessings. The name Aatikah carries the meaning “Grateful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aatikah usually hope their child will grow to embody grateful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who has been blessed with gratitude and humility.
data.etymology: Aatikah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grateful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aatikah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عاطیکة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني الجمال والمحبة، ويستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتصف المرأة الجميلة والمحبوبة، وله أهمية كبيرة في التقاليد الإسلامية والثقافة العربية

in_urdu.name: عاطیکہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربي اصل کا ایک مؤنث نام، جو خूबصورتی اور محبت کی علامت ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں پیاری اور خوبصورت خواتین کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کی اہمیت جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں بہت زیادہ ہے

in_hindi.name: आतीका
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरबी मूल का एक स्त्री नाम, जो सुंदरता और प्रेम का प्रतीक है, और इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदर और प्यारी महिलाओं के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, और इसका महत्व भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत अधिक है

data.cultural_impact: The name Aatikah may not be widely recognized in the English-speaking world, but it holds a special significance within the Islamic community. In Arabic, the name "Aatikah" means "ancestress" or "foremother." Historically, this name was given to women who were revered for their strong sense of gratitude and devotion to Allah. In Islamic culture, gratitude and acknowledging the blessings of Allah are highly valued traits, and the name Aatikah serves as a powerful reminder of this aspect of Islamic spirituality.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aatikah encapsulates the Islamic belief in the importance of gratitude towards Allah. The name signifies a deep appreciation for the blessings and mercy bestowed upon us by Allah. It serves as a reminder to always be thankful for the gifts we have received, and to offer constant gratitude through prayer, good deeds, and acts of kindness. By embodying the spirit of Aatikah, we can strive to bring positive change to ourselves and to the world around us.
